name: Cart Product Images Woocommmerce
author: Adnan Hyder Pervez

sections.description:
By default, the WooCommerce cart page includes product images and links to product pages in your shop for each item in the cart. By using this plugin you can enable or disable cart images and also remove product links from cart items when needed.
for more help in documentation https://xpertcodes.com

or you can email me as well 12345adnan@gmail.com
See screenshots

Features

  • Enable or disable product images in the cart.
  • Remove product links from cart items.
  • Hide product prices in cart rows.
  • Hide product subtotals in cart rows.
  • Hide quantity fields in cart rows.
  • Hide remove item links.
  • Disable WooCommerce coupon fields.
  • Hide WooCommerce cross-sell products.
  • Simple admin settings screen.
  • Built for WooCommerce stores.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Navigate to WC CPIW in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Choose whether cart images and product links should be shown.
sections.faq:
Can I enable or disable cart images from the admin panel?

Yes.

Can I remove product links from cart items?

Yes. Version 8.0.0 adds a dedicated setting for product links.

In case of any difficulties in setting up your plugin, write an email to 12345adnan@gmail.com
sections.changelog:
9.1.0

  • Added a new setting to hide WooCommerce cross-sell products in the cart.
  • Added filters to remove cross-sell IDs and totals when the setting is enabled.
  • Updated admin settings storage for the new cart merchandising control.

9.0.0

  • Added controls to hide cart item price, subtotal, quantity, and remove links.
  • Added option to disable WooCommerce coupon fields.
  • Expanded the plugin from image/link control into cart layout cleanup.

8.0.0

  • Added an option to remove product links from WooCommerce cart items.
  • Added nonce verification when saving plugin settings.
  • Updated release metadata and documentation.

1.0.1

  • Updated readme.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
